name: Sheermal
description: A slightly sweet saffron-milk bread, brushed with ghee and baked in a tandoor.

effects.note: Saffron is the defining flavour here, not a background spice — but even a generous dish's worth of threads is a small fraction of the roughly 28-30mg a day of standardized extract used in the depression trials. Unani tradition names zafran mood-lifting on its own grounds, and clinical trials, including a 2025 study of over 200 people, back a measurable effect on low mood at that extract dose, cited in depression-treatment guidelines alongside standard care. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
